points.text: Time to step up if: people come back to you and bring friends; the same questions repeat from person to person; there are almost no free hours left in your week.
Too early if: you cannot yet explain your approach in five minutes; after each session you are left with “I don't know what to do with this”.
A ceiling is not “too few clients”.
More clients does not mean growth.

points: You should step up if people come back and bring friends, questions repeat from person to person, and your week has almost no free hours.
It is too soon if you cannot explain your approach in five minutes or if you do not know what to do after sessions.
A ceiling is not the same as having too few clients.
Having more clients does not mean you are experiencing growth.
